title: Slice formula: τ(M̃, θ∘π, ξ′)(η) = ∫_0^1 τ(M, θ, ξ)(φ(s)) ds
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k], with Φ, π, Φ′, y₀, e₀ = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 and ι(v) = Φ(0, v) as in the parent, and assume (MP): for every A ⊆ ℝ^P that is Hᵐ-null-measurable, countably m-rectifiable and has Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, H^{m+1}⌞{y : π(y) ∈ A} = Φ′_*(L¹ ⊗ Hᵐ⌞A). Let IsRectifiableTriple univ m M θ ξ hold in ℝ^P with θ ≥ 1 on M, and let ξ′ : ℝ^{P+1} → Λ_{m+1}(ℝ^{P+1}) satisfy ξ′(Φ(s, x))(α) = ξ(x)(β) whenever β(v) = α(e₀, ιv_1, …, ιv_m) for all v. Let η : ℝ^{P+1} → Λ^{m+1}(ℝ^{P+1}) and φ : ℝ → (ℝ^P → Λ^m(ℝ^P)) be arbitrary (DifferentialForm), such that y ↦ θ(π(y))·ξ′(y)(η(y)) is H^{m+1}-integrable on M̃ := {y : π(y) ∈ M ∧ y₀ ∈ (0, 1)} and φ(s)(x)(v) = η(Φ(s, x))(e₀, ιv_1, …, ιv_m) for all s ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ ℝ^P, v ∈ (ℝ^P)^m. Then ∫_{M̃} θ̃ ξ′(η) dH^{m+1} = ∫_0^1 (∫_M θ ξ(φ(s)) dHᵐ) ds, i.e. tauAction (m+1) M̃ (θ ∘ π) ξ′ η = ∫ s in 0..1, tauAction m M θ ξ (φ s).
